g.text: daily: weekdays 09:00, prices, foreign exchange rates, portfolio
weekly: Saturdays 10:00, refresh, screen, analyze, publish
refresh: download data in order: Damodaran, fundamentals, end-of-day (EOD) prices, foreign exchange (FX) rates
screen: rank the universe with the quality gates, value indicators and trap detection into a shortlist
analyze: value each shortlisted company and write its report
portfolio: sync holdings, detect events, write alerts
site: build the static viewer from the analysis sidecars
Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval (EDGAR)
Tiingo, end-of-day (EOD) prices, default provider, with EDGAR fundamentals
Stooq, alternative prices source, with EDGAR fundamentals
Financial Modeling Prep (FMP), alternative provider for fundamentals, prices and foreign exchange (FX)
alert message by email or Telegram
Gap: with the default providers the FX refresh stores no rates for non-USD currencies; only Financial Modeling Prep supplies them.

Verdict by margin of safety (MoS = intrinsic value ÷ current price): 1.3 or more is potentially undervalued, 1.0 or more is around fair value, below 1.0 is potentially overvalued, n/a without a price. Viewer filters: undervalued, fair, overvalued, na.
1. bot refresh --prices, in rounds until nothing is deferred
fundamentals, prices and exchange rates, alternative provider
quality gates, value indicators, trap detection and ranking weights
passed candidates of the latest run, by rank
committed to master by the publish script
quality gates and trap detection for holdings
fundamentals for quality gates and trap detection
alerts sent when a notifier is configured
